# JoyDown

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Joystick](BlitzBasic-Joystick)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
JoyDown:Int32 button:Int32, port:Int32=0
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Tells whether a joystick button is held down right now. Buttons are counted from 1.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | Int32 | required | The button number, 1 to 32. |
| `port` | Int32 | `0` | The joystick to ask, counted from 0. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** 1 while the button is held down, otherwise 0.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	If JoyType() = 0 Then
		Text 10, 10, "No joystick connected"
	Else
		For b = 1 To 8
			If JoyDown(b) Then Color 255, 80, 80 Else Color 70, 70, 70
			Rect 10 + (b - 1) * 38, 100, 30, 30, 1
		Next
	EndIf
	Color 255, 255, 255
	Flip
Wend
```
